og_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly kicks off with a deadly survival round. With 100,000 geniuses on the prowl, Ji Ning learns that running away is the smartest strategy. And Lü Dongbin shows up for the free wine.

twitter_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly is here! Ji Ning learns fast: when 100+ Wanxiang Adepts hunt you, you run. Meanwhile, Lü Dongbin and other legends crash the viewing party.

lore_anchors.definition: The leader of the Eight Immortals in Chinese folklore, a rogueish swordsman. In the novel, he’s a Pure Yang True Immortal who combines the teachings of two great powers into his Sword Dao, making him one of the most feared swordsmen in the Three Realms.

A high-ranking Buddhist bodhisattva and a Pure Yang True Immortal in the novel. Known for his perpetually gentle smile and kind nature, he’s a regular attendant of the Buddha who traveled to the Grand Xia to watch the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
The highest rank of combat-ready immortal below the Daofather level. These beings have mastered a Grand Dao and are considered top-tier powers who can influence the fate of entire major worlds.

A magic treasure containing a vast, closed world used as the arena for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly’s first round. 100,000+ Wanxiang Adepts fight inside its boundaries, and only the last 96 will pass.

The Grand Xia Dynasty’s grand tournament to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts. Winners are often taken as disciples by the supreme powers of the Three Realms. It occurs once every period of time and attracts geniuses from 3,600 commanderies.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did so many Wanxiang Adepts immediately target Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning killed a Loose Immortal during the pre-tournament phase, making him the #1 known threat. In a survival arena of 100,000 nearly-equal geniuses, eliminating the strongest first is the smartest group strategy—if they don't, he'll likely be a finalist.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is Lü Dongbin and why is he important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Lü Dongbin is the leader of the legendary Eight Immortals from Chinese mythology. In Desolate Era, he's a Pure Yang True Immortal who studied under two great powers and merged their teachings into his Sword Dao. He's famous for his thick skin, trickster personality, and supreme combat power. His appearance signals that the Immortal Fortunes Assembly is being watched by Three Realms-level powers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does 'Pure Yang True Immortal' mean?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A Pure Yang True Immortal has mastered a Grand Dao and transcended the mortal world completely. They are the highest tier of combatant below the Daofather level and can influence the fate of entire major worlds. In this chapter, eight of them show up to watch the competition, showing how high the stakes are.
